    Representation-finite pieces #

    All indecomposable modules over a connected representation-finite convex piece of the cover are directing, and the same holds for its quotients by idempotents.

    ∃ (b : ℕ), ∀ (N : AR.FDMod k (PieceAlg k S)), AR.IndNT N → Module.finrank k N.carrier ≤ b

    Dimensions of indecomposables over a representation-finite piece are bounded.
